sinopsis.es: Mario 'el Rulo', artista trashumante, pasa por el pueblo de Carlos, un empleado municipal que sueña con ser artista. Nace una amistad y Carlos lo deja todo para seguirlo.
sinopsis.en: Mario 'el Rulo' is a wandering performer who passes through the town of Carlos, a municipal clerk who dreams of being an artist; a friendship is born and Carlos leaves everything to follow him.
